subject: working on predefined standalone training and test datasets

messages.author: 1ce423fbbf6e3c92
messages.subject: working on predefined standalone training and test datasets
parts:
Hi all,

I have just started working with rattle 3.0.2 r169 on R 3.0.3 on Win7. I have a question. I have predefined standalone training and test datasets defined in R. How can I tell the rattle that the first one is my training dataset so that it does not partition it to training/validate/test datasets and uses all the data on training set? (off course by GUI without manipulating the code)

Thank you in advance
Hamideh

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: working on predefined standalone training and test datasets
parts:
Simply load that as the dataset into Rattle (if it is already in R then use the R Dataset option on the Data tab), and uncheck the Partition check button. The whole dataset will be used for training.  Then to test, on the Evaluate tab select the other data set using the R Dataset option there.

Graham Williams
http://togaware.com
